description: This file defines a function to remove lightweight markdown formatting from a text string while preserving readability for TTS and fallback channels. It uses regular expressions to identify and strip markdown syntax such as bold, italics, strikethrough, headers, blockquotes, horizontal rules, inline code, and excessive newlines.
